name: starpulse-sessions
description: A Sessions tab in the Claude Code terminal dock: every session on the host, the Board task each holds, a click to switch to its tmux session, and archive and resume. Terminal and tmux only.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: nerd draws Nerd Font v3 icons (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal); plain draws ordinary Unicode characters. A terminal cannot report its font, so set plain when icons show as boxes.
